run_postprocess_encoded_docs: run the script to strip redundant whitespace tokens from SentencePiece-encoded Choe-Charniak documents
process_line: process a single line of space-separated token IDs and return comma-separated postprocessed token IDs
postprocess_token_ids: postprocess a list of token IDs by removing redundant whitespace tokens after non-terminals
create_sentencepiece_vocab: create a SentencePieceVocab object from a .vocab file for token ID postprocessing
run_main_cli: run the CLI entry point with --vocab, --input, and --output flags to transform encoded documents
